desc:
👍 Leave a THUMBS UP for MORE UPDATES! 👍

🐕The pups have flipped the daycare upside down and the worker has QUIT! Unleash your inner organizer and sort through HUNDREDS of items! And get the daycare back to BRAND NEW!

🖥️ PC Controls:

CLICK - Interact / Place
F - Drop
Q - Shop
U - Upgrades
Z,X,C,V - Abilities
T - Unlock Mouse

🎮 Controller Controls:

RT - Interact / Place
LT - Drop
X / Square - Shop 
B / Circle - Upgrades 
DPAD - Abilities

🤝 Clean up solo or team up with friends!
🏁 Race to earn the fastest cleanup times on the leaderboard!
🔓 Unlock upgrades, helpful tools, and special abilities to make every cleanup quicker and more fun!
